entries.en: to think of, to love by pondering on it; to long for
to remember with love the beloved; to recall affectionately

entries.zh: 忆着；思念并渴望所爱之人
entries.en: to remember and long for the beloved, pondering on him or her
to love and yearn for; to admire with longing
to love wife and children
entries.notes: 妻/子两音节标注 T99 污损难辨，词义依汉字与西语栏补定。

entries.en: brotherly love, to love one another as brothers; friendship
mutual love between brothers or friends
entries.notes: 「爱」音节标 T99 污损，义依汉字与西语栏。

entries.zh: 情；恩爱、恋情（所爱之人/情爱）
entries.en: love, affection; the beloved (amada)
entries.notes: 汉字「情」与西语 amada 略有出入，取情爱义；官话音节一处 T99。

entries.zh: 母子情；母亲爱子女之情
entries.en: a mother's love for her children; maternal affection
entries.notes: M 栏第四音节 chêng 读音存疑（reconstruction 标 ?），义依西语栏。

entries.en: to love with deep affection; warm, heartfelt love

entries.zh: 割吊人；使人思念成疾、害相思（令所爱者憔悴）
entries.en: to make one's lover pine away with longing; love-sickness
entries.notes: 汉字「割吊人」与官话对音略有出入（Cān tiaū），取害相思之义；M 栏一字 T99。

entries.en: love, affection (to love)
to love deeply, one's affections stirred
to love much, to be fond of

entries.zh: 春心；春心荡漾（如女子般爱抚亲昵）
entries.en: amorous desire, spring lust; to caress lovingly as a woman (ut mulier)
entries.notes: 两处 T99 污损；义依西语栏 amar haciendo caricias ut mulier 与汉字春心。

entries.zh: 〔原件此字存疑：敎/数〕纏爱人；极亲昵地爱抚（疑为「敎人」类条目，字面难定）
entries.en: to caress and dote on greatly (head character uncertain: 敎/數)
entries.notes: source_H 本身标注 [疑:敎/數]，且释义与 hiāu-lâng 音对不上嫂字，存疑处理。

entries.zh: 意愿；真心意愿（真心所爱）
entries.en: to love truly, of one's own will; heartfelt willingness
entries.notes: M 栏首字 T99、R 栏一处 T99；意愿与 amar verdaderamente 的对应取意愿义。

entries.en: to cherish what one loves as one's own possession; longing thought

entries.zh: 私情外意；淫乱不正之情（邪情私欲）
entries.en: illicit, disordered love; lust and unchaste desire
entries.notes: 西语栏文字残乱（m enteut），依汉字私情外意与 con desonestidad 定为邪淫之情。

entries.zh: 思念；朝夕思念、念念不忘
entries.en: to think of what one loves, ever speaking of it; constant remembrance
entries.notes: 「念」音节拆记为 li-m，展开依赖推断；义依汉字思念。

entries.en: to long for and desire something; fond remembrance

entries.zh: 相痛；夫妻相爱（婚后相爱）
entries.en: married couple's mutual love, conjugal affection
entries.notes: 汉字「相痛」当为「相同疼惜」类写法，R 栏两处 T99；义依西语栏 amar se los casados。
